query:
select
            (ts / ?1) * ?1 as "ts!: i64",
            mount_point as "mount_point!: String",
            cast(max(total_bytes) as integer) as "total_bytes!: i64",
            cast(avg(available_bytes) as integer) as "available_bytes!: i64"
        from filesystem_samples
        where ts >= ?2 and ts <= ?3
        group by 1, 2
        order by 2, 1
